topic: Hard weeks as training: when work is heavy, sleep is short and life gets rough we want to stop training and wait for life to get easier; the difficulty is the sparring partner, and a hard week is exactly what the training was for
figure: Epictetus, Stoic teacher c. 50-135 AD (Discourses 1.24.1-2: it is difficulties that show what people are; when one comes, remember that, like a trainer, God has matched you with a rough young opponent, so that you may become an Olympic victor, and that cannot happen without sweat). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request

lines: สัปดาห์ที่งานหนัก นอนก็ไม่พอ

ความยากคือคู่ซ้อมที่ชีวิตส่งมาให้
